title: Maths constitutional rules
rules: Default decimal ooRexx mathematical work to 50 requested digits plus explicit guard digits.
Precision and representation transitions are mathematical events and must be evidenced.
Exact values remain exact until an explicit permitted domain transition occurs.
Formatting is presentation, never mutation of mathematical representation.
Every non-trivial result can retain provider, version, algorithm, representation, guarantee scope, checks, warnings, derivation and implementation lineage.
A proof proves an explicit claim under explicit assumptions; PROVED, DISPROVED and INDETERMINATE are distinct.
Proof obligations are distinct from supporting diagnostics.
Agreement between approximate implementations is not proof of N correct digits.
Do-it-again-differently should choose materially different providers or algorithms when available.
Exact algebra, symbolic proof, rigorous enclosure and numerical reproduction are distinct evidence strengths.
A valid enclosure may be mathematically correct yet weak because of dependency or over-enclosure.
Lossy representations such as INT8/NF4 must retain full quantization state and declared error scope.
Providers supply computation; Maths owns mathematical meaning.
